newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks sag at noon on uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks sag at noon on uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks sagged at noon on Tuesday as big investors stayed out because of political and economic uncertainty, dealers said.

"The new government has yet to come out with its economic policies and investors are in a wait-and-see mood," dealer Hina Akhlaq said. "There is little activity and until something really happens, major players will remain on the sidelines."
Dealer Mohammad Iqbal said technically the market was oversold, but small players were in a panic. "Today is the last settlement day and short-covering is expected tomorrow."
The Karachi index fell 22.59 points, or 1.38 percent, to 1,612.82 at noon. Losers beat gainers 274 to 19. Dewan Salman Fibres fell 1.40 to 42.60. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
